## Areas of Expertise

```{r}
#| label: SPARQL
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# 1. Fetch SPARQL data from QLever endpoint
sparql_query <- "
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema>
PREFIX target: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q97455964>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?score ?topic ?topicLabel WHERE {
  {
    SELECT (SUM(?score_) AS ?score) ?topic WHERE {
      {
        SELECT (64 AS ?score_) ?topic WHERE {
          target: wdt:P101 ?topic .
        }
      }
      UNION {
        SELECT (32 AS ?score_) ?topic WHERE {
          ?work wdt:P50 target: ;
                wdt:P921 ?topic .
        }
      }
      UNION {
        SELECT (16 AS ?score_) ?topic WHERE {
          ?work wdt:P50 target: ;
                (wdt:P921/wdt:P279) ?topic .
        }
      }
      UNION {
        SELECT (8 AS ?score_) ?topic WHERE {
          ?work wdt:P50 target: ;
                (wdt:P921/wdt:P279/wdt:P279) ?topic .
        }
      }
      UNION {
        SELECT (32 AS ?score_) ?topic WHERE {
          ?work wdt:P50 target: ;
                wdt:P4510 ?topic .
        }
      }
      UNION {
        SELECT (16 AS ?score_) ?topic WHERE {
          ?work wdt:P50 target: ;
                (wdt:P4510/wdt:P279) ?topic .
        }
      }
      UNION {
        SELECT (8 AS ?score_) ?topic WHERE {
          ?work wdt:P50 target: ;
                (wdt:P4510/wdt:P279/wdt:P279) ?topic .
        }
      }
    }
    GROUP BY ?topic
  }
  ?topic rdfs:label ?topicLabel .
  FILTER (LANG(?topicLabel) = \"en\")
}
ORDER BY DESC(?score)
LIMIT 16
"

# Hit QLever Wikidata SPARQL API endpoint
data_raw <- httr2::request(base_url = "https://qlever.cs.uni-freiburg.de/api/wikidata") |>
  httr2::req_url_query(query = sparql_query, format = "json") |>
  httr2::req_headers(`User-Agent` = "QuartoBuildScript/1.0")|>
  httr2::req_perform() |>
  httr2::resp_body_json()
```

```{r}
#| label: Transform
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# 2. Parse results into a clean data frame with url and qid
df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(data_raw$results$bindings, function(x) {
  topic_url <- x$topic$value
  data.frame(
    score = as.numeric(x$score$value),
    label = x$topicLabel$value,
    url   = topic_url,
    qid   = sub(".*/", "", topic_url),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

# 3. Calculate circle packing layout
packing <- packcircles::circleProgressiveLayout(df$score, sizetype = "area")
df <- cbind(df, packing)
df$id <- seq_len(nrow(df))

# Calculate smart label wrapping and dynamic font scaling per item
df$wrapped_label <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
  lbl <- df$label[i]
  n_char <- nchar(lbl)

  # Target width wraps more aggressively for long strings
  target_width <- max(5, round(sqrt(df$r[i]) * 1.8))

  # Replace hyphens with spaces temporarily for better wrapping if needed
  clean_lbl <- gsub("-", " - ", lbl)
  wrapped <- paste(strwrap(clean_lbl, width = target_width), collapse = "\n")
  gsub(" - ", "-", wrapped) # restore hyphens
})

# Dynamic font sizing considering both circle radius AND string length
df$font_size <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
  n_char <- nchar(df$label[i])
  base_size <- df$r[i] * 0.35

  # Penalize font size for longer string lengths
  size_factor <- ifelse(n_char > 25, 0.5, ifelse(n_char > 15, 0.7, 1.0))
  pmax(1.8, pmin(5.5, base_size * size_factor))
})

# Format explicit window.open JavaScript string for Quarto HTML output
df$onclick <- sprintf("window.open(\"%s\", \"_blank\");", df$url)
df$tooltip <- paste0("<b>", df$label, "</b><br>Score: ", df$score, "<br>QID: ", df$qid)

# Generate circle vertices for ggplot polygons
dat.gg <- packcircles::circleLayoutVertices(packing, npoints = 50)
dat.gg <- merge(dat.gg, df[, c("id", "label", "score", "url", "qid", "onclick", "tooltip")], by = "id")
```

```{r}
#| label: Plot
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Interactive circle packing chart displaying areas of expertise sized by
#|   score, with labels colored using the batlowK palette.

# 4. Plot Construction
p <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggiraph::geom_polygon_interactive(
    data = dat.gg,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      group = id,
      fill = score,
      tooltip = tooltip,
      onclick = onclick,
      data_id = id
    ),
    colour = "white",
    size = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = khroma::color("batlowK")(256)
  ) +
  ggiraph::geom_text_interactive(
    data = df,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      label = wrapped_label,
      size = font_size,
      tooltip = tooltip,
      onclick = onclick,
      data_id = id
    ),
    color = "white",
    fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 0.8,
    check_overlap = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_size_identity() +
  ggplot2::theme_void() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm")
  ) +
  ggplot2::coord_equal()

# 5. Render Interactive Widget
ggiraph::girafe(
  ggobj = p,
  width_svg = 8,
  height_svg = 8,
  options = list(
    ggiraph::opts_hover(css = "cursor:pointer;fill-opacity:1.0;stroke:black;stroke-width:2px;"),
    ggiraph::opts_tooltip(css = "background-color:black;color:white;padding:8px;border-radius:4px;")
  )
)
```
